SECONDARY_2_5.label: SECONDARY
SECONDARY_2_5.required_section_4_caveat: At a reference successor capability of 2.5, g_star lies below the honest median of g, every honest calibration run spends long spans above it, and k is accordingly large. A hazard there measures persistence far beyond honest behavior rather than the approach to a defection boundary.
